info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Market Data Information Provider Status API
info.description: The Market Data Information Provider Status API enables users to assess the operational status of various information providers within the banking domain. This API offers real-time insights into the availability and performance of market data services. Typical consumers include developers and data analysts who rely on accurate market information for trading or financial analysis. By utilizing this API, teams can ensure they have up-to-date status checks to make informed decisions regarding data source reliability.

get.summary: Retrieve the operational status of the information provider.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch the current operational status of the information provider within the market data service. It provides insights into the health and availability of the data feeds being offered.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the current status of the information provider operation. It includes necessary parameters to ensure the request is processed correctly.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the operational status of the information provider.

GetMarketDataInformationProviderStatusRe.description: Represents the status of the information provider operation in the context of market data retrieval.
